commands: for m in $({ git diff --name-only "$(git merge-base HEAD origin/master)"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | cut -d/ -f1 | sort -u); do [ -f "$m/package.json" ] || continue; echo "== $m"; (cd "$m" && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci; } && npm run --if-present typecheck && npm run lint && npm run --if-present test:run && npm run build:dev) || exit 1; done
